fields.videoBrief: Shaky handheld vertical phone video through an apartment window, zooming in on a tilted trench box in a flooded muddy trench, firefighters standing at yellow tape along the edge, fire trucks with lights flashing, a news helicopter heard and briefly seen circling overhead, the person filming breathing hard as they pan across the site

instructorNote: Misinformation and family-pressure inject: show the card, then tell the PE and SAFE out loud that the hotline has taken 19 calls in 10 minutes, three of them from people saying they are workers' relatives, and play the 10:55 Dayton Ledger call from Marisa Kline (937-555-0147, kline@daytonledger.example), who claims "two dead, clearly marked line" and files at noon. Watch whether the PE checks that the owner's representative has been told before giving a short holding statement as the only voice (no names, no deaths, no cause, a time for the next update), and whether SAFE moves family contact off the hotline and into direct company contact.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Vertical phone snapshot taken through a slightly smudged apartment window on an overcast April morning, looking down onto a muddy sewer construction trench on a city street. A steel trench box sits visibly tilted inside the wet, partly flooded excavation. Two red fire engines and a heavy rescue truck are parked along a chain-link fence, their emergency lights glowing. Firefighters in tan turnout gear and helmets crouch and stand at the trench edge behind yellow tape. An orange excavator is stopped beside a spoil pile, its bucket resting on the ground. Wet asphalt, puddles and brick row houses line the street. Grey diffuse light, faint window glare and reflections, slight motion blur, tense and chaotic mood. Setting: at the edge of an open utility trench: a yellow trench box, a ladder, spoil piled back from the edge, a backhoe, orange utility flags, caution tape and a gray sky, during a power outage, blackout, emergency lighting only, dim low light

mediaBrief.videoPrompt: Shaky handheld vertical phone video filmed through an apartment window on a grey overcast morning. The camera zooms in unsteadily on a steel trench box tilted inside a flooded, muddy sewer trench. Firefighters in turnout gear stand and kneel at yellow tape along the trench edge, one pointing down into the excavation. The camera pans across red fire engines with flashing lights parked at a chain-link fence and an idle orange excavator, then tilts up briefly to a helicopter circling in the low grey sky before swinging back down to the trench. Window glare, smudges and autofocus hunting, wet streets and puddles, anxious amateur framing.
